title: Jod Na Nawood
description: Jod Na Nawood was an enigmatic scoundrel. Wim, Fern, KB, and Neel found him in the brig at Starport Borgo. They assumed he was a Jedi when he broke them out of their joint cell and helped them escape to their ship. He had a checkered past and other aliases, including Silvo and Crimson Jack. One thing is certain—he was very interested in finding the mythical treasure of At Attin.
